shots.title: Reap or ignore dangling workflow executions from dead sessions in workflow-step-gate and surface them in status/briefing with a clear-command (#621)

hazards.description: [architect review] Dead-session evidence could pause a live teammate's execution after a 10-minute heartbeat lapse (peer cleanStaleSessions deletes the row); fixed with a 60-minute execution-quiet grace window.
[code review] Dead-session staleness was dead code in production: no shipped path set session_id on executions. slope sprint run and the loop adapter now bind executions to SLOPE_SESSION_ID.
[code review] slope status could advertise a live parallel execution as dangling with a cleanup command that would pause it; surfacing now excludes newer-running evidence and passes currentSessionId.

shots.notes: findStaleWorkflowExecutions now counts a dead owning session as staleness evidence — gated on session tracking being in use and never for the invoking session — and slope status lists dangling executions with the cleanup command.

shots.title: Scope edit and Bash gates to the repo root and exempt non-sprint commands like gh issue create (#621)

hazards.description: [architect review] isWithinRepo lacked realpath handling (symlinked roots could bypass the gate) and cast file_path unchecked; advisory recommended unvalidated phase complete. All fixed.

shots.notes: workflow-step-gate allows any Edit/Write whose target resolves outside cwd before touching the store. Main had already narrowed phase-boundary to slope commands; a gh issue create regression test locks that in.

shots.title: Add phase-ledger staleness heuristic — scorecards far past the boundary downgrade block to warn (#621)

hazards.description: [architect review] Raw sprintOrderValue mis-decoded modern sprint ids ending in 5 (245 read as 24.5), making the staleness downgrade both fail-open and fail-closed; fixed with roadmap-aware ordering and roadmap-membership evidence.

shots.notes: When scorecards exist at or past the target phase's first sprint, phase-boundary emits a non-blocking advisory recommending slope phase complete N instead of denying.

conditions: Main had already fixed parts of #621 (gate resync on invocation, phase-boundary matching only slope commands) — the residual gaps were dead-session staleness, out-of-repo edit gating, status surfacing, and the ledger staleness heuristic.
bunker_locations: Dead-session staleness can misfire in multi-agent setups if guarded only by session-row presence; it is fenced to tracked-session repos and never the invoking session, pending review scrutiny.
yardage_book_updates: Existing workflow-step-gate tests used an out-of-repo default edit path; repo-scoping changes flip such fixtures — keep guard test fixtures inside the temp repo.
findStaleWorkflowExecutions store parameter widened with Partial getActiveSessions; mock stores without it are unaffected.
course_management_notes: Issue #621 was filed from an older slope version; each ticket was re-scoped against current main before implementation.
